links.outcome: Reading grade level of LLM-generated colorectal patient education materials versus baseline
links.effect: Gemini grade level 5.9 vs baseline 7.7 (P<0.001); ChatGPT 12.5 and Copilot 8.8 worse than baseline (both P<0.001).
links.quote: Gemini-generated materials demonstrated improved readability (grade level 5.9; P < 0.001) from baseline (7.7), whereas ChatGPT (12.5) and Copilot (8.8) performed worse (both P < 0.001).

links.outcome: Reading grade level of LLM-generated patient materials relative to appropriate patient reading level
links.effect: Gemini 5.9 grade level; ChatGPT 12.5 and Copilot 8.8, worse than baseline 7.7 (P<0.001).
links.quote: Gemini-generated materials demonstrated improved readability (grade level 5.9; P < 0.001) from baseline (7.7), whereas ChatGPT (12.5) and Copilot (8.8) performed worse (both P < 0.001).

screen.reason: The study evaluates and compares the readability and usability of colorectal patient education materials generated by three different commercial LLMs against existing baseline materials.
